narrations.title: The Hungry Encounter
narrations.narration: Barnaby was happily observing a tiny ladybug when a large shadow loomed over him. It was Leo the lion, clutching his tummy as it rumbled loudly.

narrations.title: The Clever Idea
narrations.narration: Barnaby didn't panic. Instead, he tapped his chin, his ears perked up, and he formed a clever plan.

narrations.title: The Wise Observer
narrations.narration: Barnaby hopped briskly ahead, leading the hungry Leo toward the old stone well. High above on a branch, Sage the owl watched the pair with a puzzled smile.

narrations.title: The Rival in the Well
narrations.narration: Leo stomped to the edge of the well and peered into the darkness. He saw a lion with a giant mane looking back at him.

narrations.title: The Big Splosh
narrations.narration: The reflection mimicked Leo's every move. Fuming with frustration, Leo leaned too far and tumbled right into the shallow water with a loud splash.

narrations.title: The Soggy Retreat
narrations.narration: Leo scrambled out of the well. He was soaking wet, his blue bib dripping, and the other lion had completely vanished. He was far too damp to hunt.

narrations.title: Victory and Wisdom
narrations.narration: Barnaby hopped away with a delighted giggle, while Sage continued to flutter his wings in a supportive, though bewildered, manner.
